comparison_summary.conclusion: The current models APPEAR to have higher error metrics because they are forecasting on the truthful, un-leaked reality. The base paper 'outperforms' only mathematically due to target data leakage and calculating MSE on Z-scores instead of original units. No further architectural tuning will bridge this gap without re-introducing data leakage.

base_paper.R2: Not explicitly given in table, claimed ~1.0 in text
base_paper.notes: MSE calculated on standardized units (Z-scores) or with severe leakage.

current_implementation.notes: Calculated on raw Trillion BTU units. TimeSeries cross-validated to prevent lookahead bias.
